 Palo woman charged with $21,000 in SNAP fraud 
 By Lacey Reeves Published : Nov. 7, 2026 at 2:46 PM CST | Updated : 7 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google CEDAR RAPIDS, Iowa (KCRG) - A Palo woman is charged with two felonies after a state investigation found she gave false information about her income to get more food assistance than she was owed.
 Court documents show 38-year-old Aeryka Walker gave false documents and statements to the Department of Health and Human Services about how much she earned for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) funds.
 Aeryka Walker (KCRG) A criminal complaint showed she reported less income than she made or said she had none, while records showed she was working and getting paid regularly.
 Documents said Walker was overpaid $21,789 in SNAP funds. 
 The investigation said the overpayment was often $300 or more a month.
 Walker is charged with ongoing criminal conduct and first-degree fraud.
